triples.subject: Alyosha
triples.quote: Both sides threw stones incessantly. Many of the group had their pockets full too. “What are you about! Aren’t you ashamed? Six against one! Why, you’ll kill him,” cried Alyosha.

triples.subject: Smurov
triples.quote: “Give it him, hit him back, Smurov,” they all shouted. But Smurov, the left-handed boy, needed no telling, and at once revenged himself;

triples.subject: Wisp of Tow
triples.quote: They all shouted: “Aha, he is funking, he is running away. Wisp of tow!”

triples.subject: Schoolboys' stone fight
triples.quote: coming out into Mihailovsky Street, which is divided by a small ditch from the High Street (our whole town is intersected by ditches), he saw a group of schoolboys

triples.subject: Wisp of Tow
triples.quote: He is a beast, he stabbed Krassotkin in class the other day with a penknife.

triples.subject: Wisp of Tow
triples.quote: “But I hit Smurov on the head!” cried the boy.

triples.subject: Wisp of Tow
triples.quote: he flew at Alyosha himself, and before Alyosha had time to move, the spiteful child had seized his left hand with both of his and bit his middle finger.

triples.subject: Alyosha
triples.quote: Alyosha took out his handkerchief and bound it tightly round his injured hand.
